traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria for Story 020.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION are satisfied: - File-level annotations: ensureFileSupportsAnnotation enforces presence of @supports in test files, with optional safe placeholder auto-fix and clear message (missingFileSupports). - Describe block story references: handleDescribeCall applies a configurable regex (default 'Story [0-9]+\.[0-9]+-') to describe descriptions and reports missingDescribeStory when violated. - Test name requirement prefixes: handleItOrTestCall enforces that it/test descriptions start with a [REQ-...] prefix, reporting missingReqPrefix and optionally normalizing malformed prefixes without inventing IDs. - Quality & performance: the rule is implemented using ESLint best practices (meta, schema, messages, create), uses limited AST traversal, small helper functions, and safe auto-fixes. - Integration: the rule is registered in src/index.ts, included in TRACEABILITY_RULE_SEVERITIES at severity error, and thereby enabled in both recommended and strict configs; other tests confirm configs work with the rule set. - Error messages: the three messageIds match the story’s examples and are exercised in the tests. - Framework support: isTestCallName covers describe, it, test, and context, and getCalleeName supports MemberExpression forms like describe.each and test.skip; tests demonstrate Mocha-style context compatibility. - Documentation: user-docs/api-reference.md has a dedicated section for traceability/require-test-traceability describing behavior, options, patterns, and examples consistent with the implemented rule.
Tests for this rule (tests/rules/require-test-traceability.test.ts) are present, reference this story explicitly via @supports, and all pass in the current Jest run. Taken together, the implementation, configuration, tests, and documentation provide concrete evidence that the story’s requirements and acceptance criteria are fully implemented.
